titulo.es: Strangers in their own land: Mexicans deported from Trump’s America find refuge in ‘Little LA’
titulo.en: Strangers in their own land: Mexicans deported from Trump’s America find refuge in ‘Little LA’

sintesis.es: With plentiful jobs and community support, one Mexico City neighbourhood has become a haven for those who have lived much of their lives in the US With its wide avenues lined with tall palm trees, its quaint cafes and old-school cantinas, as well as the mix of English and Spanish spoken on the street, the Tabacalera neighborhood in downtown Mexico City has a certain US feel – so much so that it is has become known as Little LA . The nickname is about more than appearances, however. In recent years, this corner of the metropolis has become a haven for many Mexicans deported from the US, particularly those who spent years or decades living across the border and for whom Mexico feels like a foreign country.

titulo.es: Hong Kong condena a los guardianes de la memoria de Tiananmen por pedir el fin de la "dictadura de partido único" en China
titulo.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’

sintesis.es: Los antiguos líderes del grupo que durante tres décadas organizó las multitudinarias vigilias del 4 de junio son declarados culpables de incitar a la subversión Leer
sintesis.en: UK Foreign Office condemns use of national security law to convict activists Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung Two Hong Kong activists who organised annual vigils marking China’s deadly Tiananmen crackdown in 1989 have been found guilty of “incitement to subversion” in one of the most high-profile cases in Hong Kong since Beijing imposed its national security law in 2020. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”, a press summary handed out to reporters said. The defendants each face a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail, with sentencing expected at a later date.

titulo.es: Colapsan negociaciones comerciales entre EE.UU. y Canadá; entran en vigor aranceles del 50% y Ottawa promete represalias
titulo.en: US-Canada trade talks collapse; 50% tariffs take effect as Ottawa vows retaliation

sintesis.es: Las negociaciones comerciales entre Estados Unidos y Canadá fracasaron tras cambios de última hora en los términos propuestos por Washington, lo que llevó a la entrada en vigor de aranceles del 50% sobre unos 20.000 millones de dólares en productos canadienses. El primer ministro Mark Carney acusó a Trump de iniciar una guerra comercial y anunció aranceles de represalia 'dólar por dólar' sobre acero, electrónica y otros productos estadounidenses, a partir del 8 de septiembre. El episodio incluyó un audio filtrado del vicepresidente JD Vance burlándose de Carney, mientras el representante comercial de EE.UU., Jamieson Greer, detalló la oferta que Canadá rechazó.
sintesis.en: Trade negotiations between the United States and Canada collapsed after last-minute changes to Washington's proposed terms, triggering 50% tariffs on approximately $20 billion worth of Canadian goods. Prime Minister Mark Carney accused Trump of starting a trade war and announced dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on US steel, electronics and other products, effective September 8. The episode included leaked audio of Vice President JD Vance mocking Carney, while US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer detailed the offer Canada rejected.

titulo.es: Muere a los 92 años Nancy Kissinger, viuda y consejera del histórico ex secretario de Estado Henry Kissinger
titulo.en: Spain's Secretary of State for Health discusses health priorities with WHO

sintesis.es: Considerada la consejera más cercana de su marido durante los años clave de la Guerra Fría, ejerció una notable influencia entre bambalinas en la política exterior estadounidense sin ostentar nunca un cargo diplomático formal Leer
sintesis.en: WHO welcomed Mr Javier Padilla Bernáldez, Spain’s Secretary of State for Health and his delegation on 23 and 24 April 2024 to discuss joint global health priorities. Amongst others, Spain's focus is on universal health coverage and health systems strengthening; pandemic response and emergency medical teams; organ and tissue transplantation; malaria and other tropical diseases; and polio. During the visit, participants focused on plans and on-going work across a number of areas, including WHO’s Transplantation Program to increase availability; ethical access and oversight of transplantation of human cells; tissues and organs.

titulo.es: Marruecos pone condiciones para recibir cadáveres de Ceuta: informes forenses y regreso de sobrevivientes
titulo.en: Spain rejects Morocco's call for talks on Ceuta and Melilla sovereignty

sintesis.es: En una entrevista con la cadena Al-Arabiya, el ministro de Justicia de Marruecos, Abdellatif Ouahbi, reclamó a España "una solución global" para recibir los cuerpos de migrantes fallecidos en la entrada masiva en Ceuta de finales de julio. Para Rabat, esa medida debe ir de la mano de informes forenses para "saber quiénes son estas personas" y la repatriación de los sobrevivientes marroquíes, entre ellos los menores. Tres semanas después, muchos migrantes siguen en las calles de Ceuta, a la espera de que se defina su situación.
sintesis.en: Morocco proposes creating a dialogue mechanism to address the future of Ceuta and Melilla, but Spain's Foreign Ministry rejects its demands and reaffirms Spanish sovereignty over both cities.

titulo.en: DR Congo receives Ebola vaccines in face of 'exponential' outbreak

sintesis.es: Casi 5000 personas se han contagiado y más de 2300 han muerto en seis provincias de la República Democrática del Congo. La OMS advierte que la epidemia sigue lejos de estar bajo control, mientras la inseguridad, los desplazamientos y la intensa movilidad de la población continúan alimentando la transmisión.
sintesis.en: The Democratic Republic of Congo has received more than 16,000 doses of an Ebola vaccine, as authorities step up efforts against the ongoing outbreak. More than 2,500 people have already died and health officials from the WHO are warning this epidemic could surpass the deadliest on record – that occurred between 2014 and 2016 and caused over 11,000 deaths across West Africa. Dr Muhammad Munir, Professor of virology at Lancaster University in the UK, helps us understand the situation on the ground.

titulo.es: Scientists solve the mystery of a brain “switch” that can trigger weight loss in opposite ways
titulo.en: Scientists solve the mystery of a brain “switch” that can trigger weight loss in opposite ways

sintesis.es: Scientists have uncovered why two seemingly opposite ways of targeting the same brain receptor can both promote weight loss. In mice, activating the GIP receptor in the brainstem reduced appetite, while blocking it in the hypothalamus removed a kind of “brake” on fullness signals. The discovery helps explain why very different obesity drugs can achieve similar results and suggests that carefully combining GIP-targeting treatments with GLP-1 drugs like those related to Wegovy and Ozempic could produce stronger effects.
